brief: Design a charming, distinctive bot mascot logo with lovable personality (inspired by Grokbot and friendly robot companions) for Sayabot — the AI agent workspace where humans and bots build together.
criteria: Cute and instantly recognizable, works at 16px favicon scale, scales across dark and light UI, clean geometric SVG construction.

concepts.name: The Pocket Saya (Selected Option A)
concepts.idea: An adorable pocket robot with a pill-shaped dome, antenna orb, ear audio pods, sparkling expressive eyes, and a warm joyful smile.
rationale: Unforgettable mascot personality that builds emotional connection and trust with users
Pill-shaped geometric dome with audio pods ensures instant silhouette recognition at 16px to 512px
Vibrant coral-orange chassis (#ff7a45) on dark void visor (#0b0e0c) stands out cleanly across web, mobile, and dark mode
Includes dedicated small-scale cut optimized for crisp rendering at tiny favicon sizes

recommendation: Option A (The Pocket Saya) — Beloved, warm, and highly memorable mascot identity perfectly aligned with Sayabot's conversational, collaborative AI platform.
next_steps: Integrated into apps/web favicon and icon set
Embedded into web app header, footer, and sidebar navigation
Deployed live to AWS Lightsail production VPS
